messages:
emily_s: Hey team — quick sync. Prospect (FinTech) asked for an on‑prem POC quote. They want: private VPC deployment, 6wk POC, 1 dedicated GPU node, and enterprise support. Asking if we can bundle platform license + 3mo reduced support for POC.
raj_sol: Thx. Quick clarifying q: is the GPU node for inference-only or training? If inference we can use our standard Dedicated SKU, if they want LLM fine‑tuning that's separate.
emily_s: Inference-only. They mentioned KV cache + KMS integration for keys. Also asked about a temporary waiver of the platform fee during the POC period.
raj_sol: KMS adds an integration surcharge (one-time). Platform fee waiver for POC is possible but usually needs Deal Desk signoff + finance ok on forecasted commit.
hana_fin: @emily_s do we have an expected commit after POC? We only waive platform fees if there's a commit >= 12 months or an annual $ amount.
emily_s: They're leaning toward a 12mo reserved commitment after POC but want to keep options. Can we propose a conditional waiver: platform fee waived for POC; if they convert to >=12mo commit within 30d, we keep discounted rate; otherwise platform fee billed retroactively?
kevin_legal: Retro billing is messy. We prefer a clawback credit in the contract: if no conversion, they owe the normal platform fee for POC months. Legal ok with conditional credit but need explicit language in SOW.
deal-desk-bot: Approval workflow kicked: discount >15% requires Deal Desk review. Please attach proposed rate card and POC SOW.
emily_s: Putting a draft here so Deal Desk can review. Proposed pricing snippet:```
- Dedicated node (inference): $12,000/mo
- On‑prem Platform license: $6,000/mo (standard)
- POC support (3mo reduced): $2,000/mo
- KMS/integration one-time: $8,000
- Proposed POC platform fee: waived for 3mo (conditional)
- Conversion credit: 20% off platform/license for first 6 months after commit
```
raj_sol: Numbers look ok. Small ask: instead of retro-billing, add "POC fee convertible to credit upon signed commitment". That avoids collections and is customer-friendly.
hana_fin: Credit approach is OK but needs a minimum post-POC commit floor, e.g., >= $150k ARR or 12mo. Otherwise we lose profitable baseline.
emily_s: Customer's expected ARR ~ $180k if they convert. I'll mark that in the proposal.
kevin_legal: Add this clause: "If Customer executes a Reserved Capacity Agreement within 30 days, Vendor will apply POC Platform Fees as a credit against the first invoice(s) up to the credited amount. If no Agreement is executed within 30 days, credits expire and standard fees apply." Legal to finalize.
deal-desk-bot: Required approvals: Finance ok? (hana_fin), Legal ok? (kevin_legal), Revenue Ops FYI.
hana_fin: Approving conditional credit with floor $150k ARR and 12mo minimum.
kevin_legal: Approving the clause as drafted; send final SOW to legal for redline.
emily_s: Cool. Two final asks: 1) Can Deal Desk approve a 20% conversion credit cap amount (not exceed 6 months of platform fees)? 2) Can we discount support during POC to $0 for first month?\ajudge: (typo placeholder message)
raj_sol: @emily_s for (1) finance says cap to 6 months is fine. For (2) support $0 for first month OK; second/third month at reduced rate $2k/mo.
hana_fin: Confirmed: credit capped at 6 months of platform fees; POC support $0 month1, $2k months 2-3.
emily_s: I'll update SOW and push to Deal Desk. Thanks all.
kevin_legal: I'll review the SOW language once you post.
deal-desk-bot: Deal Desk action item created: DD-2026-114. Please attach final SOW and forecast.
